decision.reasoning_trace: After filtering out non-speaker accessories like cases and cables, I focused on high-rated portable speakers. My consideration set included a mix of premium brands (Bang & Olufsen, JBL) and highly-rated budget alternatives (comiso, Raymate). While the JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) is the highest-rated overall, the JBL Charge 4 Renewed (prod_bluetooth_speakers_013) offers nearly identical performance and the same trusted brand reputation at a significantly more attractive price point ($89.95 vs $149.95). The high 4.7 rating for the renewed model gives me confidence in its quality, making it the best balance of value and performance in this set.
